title: “เอกนิติ” นำทีมขึ้น 4 เวทีใหญ่ วง IMF-World Bank 2026 เพิ่มโอกาสเศรษฐกิจไทย
desc: ไทยพร้อมเปิดฉาก IMF-World Bank 2026 “เอกนิติ” นำทีมขึ้น 4 เวทีใหญ่ระดับโลก พร้อมนำประเทศไทยถกทวิภาคี 30 นัดหมายกับคีย์แมนการเงิน-การคลังระดับโลกเปลี่ยนเวทีการเงินโลกเป็นโอกาสเศรษฐกิจไทย
title_cn: 埃克奈蒂率队出席 IMF-World Bank 2026，四大论坛对话为泰国经济开辟机遇
summary_cn: 泰国为 2026 年 IMF-World Bank 年会做好准备。由埃克奈蒂（Ekkachai）率领的泰国代表团将亮相四大国际论坛，并与全球 30 位金融、财政要人进行双边会谈，将国际金融舞台转化为推动泰国经济发展的机遇。

title: คนตื่นตัวแห่ใช้สิทธิ์เลือกตั้งบอร์ดประกันสังคมคึกคัก ตั้งแต่เริ่มเปิดหีบ

title_cn: 社会保障局董事会选举开票，参保人及雇主投票热烈
summary_cn: 泰国社会保障办公室（SSO）董事会选举自开票伊始就吸引了大量参保人和雇主踊跃投票。根据 SSO 监察部门主任，投票按照劳动法第 33、39、40 条条款进行，已登记参保者须在指定地点投票，未在雇主处登记的参保人不得在雇主所在地行使投票权。

title: Rescuers win most praise in Bangkok floods, not City Hall or govt
desc: An opinion survey by the National Institute of Development Administration early this month found that most respondents in recently flooded Bangkok praised rescuers, not the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration or the government.
title_cn: 曼谷洪灾中，救援人员赢得最多赞誉，远胜政府部门
summary_cn: 泰国发展管理学院（NIDA）本月初的民调显示，近期遭受洪灾的曼谷居民对救援人员的认可度最高，对曼谷市政府和国家政府的评价则相对较低。调查反映了公众对一线救援行动的信任，以及对官方应急响应的期待落差。
desc_original: An opinion survey by the National Institute of Development Administration early this month found that most respondents in recently flooded Bangkok praised rescuers, not the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration or the government.

title: ซีพีแรมปรับเกม Plant-based เน้นธรรมชาติ-รสชาติ ดันอาหารเจกินได้ทุกวัน
desc: ซีพีแรมเปลี่ยนเกมอาหารเจ เน้นวัตถุดิบธรรมชาติ-รสชาติ ลดพึ่ง Plant-based ดันเมนูเจกินได้ทุกวัน หวังขยายตลาดจากเทศกาลสู่มื้อประจำวัน ขณะที่ตลาดอาหารเจปี 69 คาดโต 8% แตะ 4.9 หมื่นล้านบาท
title_cn: CP Ram 调整素食策略，强化天然食材与风味，日常素食消费全覆盖
summary_cn: 泰国食品巨头 CP Ram 调整植物蛋白产品策略，转向强调天然食材和传统风味，减少对纯 Plant-based 成分的依赖。目标是让素食菜品从节庆市场扩展到日常三餐消费。业界预测 2026 年泰国素食市场将增长 8%，市场规模达 49 亿泰铢。
desc_original: ซีพีแรมเปลี่ยนเกมอาหารเจ เน้นวัตถุดิบธรรมชาติ-รสชาติ ลดพึ่ง Plant-based ดันเมนูเจกินได้ทุกวัน หวังขยายตลาดจากเทศกาลสู่มื้อประจำวัน ขณะที่ตลาดอาหารเจปี 69 คาดโต 8% แตะ 4.9 หมื่นล้านบาท

summary_cn: Yamaha Marine 积极推进泰国水上运输与娱乐业务的网络拓展，以应对该领域的增长势头和企业客户市场的扩大。公司正式任命 SEAT GROUP 为官方销售代理商，进一步巩固在泰国水上产业的市场位置。

desc: สมาคมโรงแรมไทยค้านสุดตัว ร่าง พ.ร.บ.ภาษีเดินทางออกนอกประเทศ เก็บเพิ่ม 1,000 บาท หวั่นทุบอุตสาหกรรมท่องเที่ยวไทยพัง ทำภาระนักท่องเที่ยวพุ่ง รวมสูงถึง 2,570 บาทต่อคน หรือ 10,280 บาทต่อครอบครัว
title_cn: 酒店业强烈反对离境税增税，担心旅游业遭重创
summary_cn: 泰国酒店协会强烈反对新草案中增加1000泰铢的国民出境旅游税，担心这将重创泰国旅游业。若草案通过，游客人均负担将达2570泰铢，每个家庭合计10280泰铢，大幅增加外国游客成本。

title: Flood victims turning to loan sharks
desc: The opposition Democrat Party has called for better access to financial assistance for flood victims in Bangkok, saying unclear and delayed relief measures have forced some affected traders to turn to loan sharks to keep their businesses afloat.
title_cn: 洪灾受害者转向高利贷
summary_cn: 在野党民主党呼吁改善洪灾受害者的财务救助途径，指出政府救灾措施不够明确且拖延，迫使部分受灾商户被迫向高利贷业者借款以维持生意，加重了灾民的经济困境。
desc_original: The opposition Democrat Party has called for better access to financial assistance for flood victims in Bangkok, saying unclear and delayed relief measures have forced some affected traders to turn to loan sharks to keep their businesses afloat.

title: PM warns of rain as cleanup begins
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul urged authorities to accelerate post-flood recovery efforts and warned 14 southern provinces to prepare for another round of heavy rainfall.
title_cn: 总理警告降雨风险，灾后清理启动
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·查尔维拉库尔敦促各级部门加快洪灾后的恢复工作，并向南部14个府发出警告，要求其为迎接新一轮强降雨做好充分准备，防止灾情进一步恶化。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul urged authorities to accelerate post-flood recovery efforts and warned 14 southern provinces to prepare for another round of heavy rainfall.

title: Labour minister calls on voters to cast ballots in SSB election
desc: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has urged insured workers and employers to participate in today’s Social Security Board (SSB) election, which will determine the future direction of an agency managing a fund worth nearly 3 trillion baht.
title_cn: 劳工部长呼吁投票者参与社会保障基金（SSB）选举
summary_cn: 泰国劳工部长于拉蓬·阿蒙维瓦特敦促被保险工人和雇主参与社会保障基金（SSB）选举。本次选举将决定这一管理近3万亿泰铢资金机构的未来方向，涉及百万从业者的养老、医疗等核心福利权益，关乎泰国社会保障体系的长期发展。
desc_original: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has urged insured workers and employers to participate in today’s Social Security Board (SSB) election, which will determine the future direction of an agency managing a fund worth nearly 3 trillion baht.

title: Cops transferred after venue raid
desc: Five senior police at Chana Songkhram station have been transferred to inactive posts pending an investigation after a special task force raided an unlicensed entertainment venue on Khao San Road and found several alleged violations.
title_cn: 警察厅查处无证娱乐场所后转岗调查
summary_cn: 曼谷警方对高山路（Khao San Road）一家无证娱乐场所进行特别任务队突袭，发现多项涉嫌违规行为。查察那颂克拉姆警察局的五名高级警官因此被调至非活跃岗位接受调查。此事涉及警方执法透明度和廉政问题，反映泰国加强娱乐场所监管的力度。
desc_original: Five senior police at Chana Songkhram station have been transferred to inactive posts pending an investigation after a special task force raided an unlicensed entertainment venue on Khao San Road and found several alleged violations.

title: Exam fraud file 'met NACC deadline', police chief says
desc: Police submitted their investigation file on fraud in local government recruitment examinations to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) within the required 30-day deadline, says national police chief Pol Gen Samran Nualma.
title_cn: 警察总长称考试舞弊案卷按期提交反贪委
summary_cn: 泰国警察总长萨兰·努兰玛宣布，警方已在规定30天期限内向国家反腐败委员会（NACC）提交地方政府招聘考试舞弊案的调查文件。该案件涉及公务员招聘考试作弊，属于严重反腐工作，当前进入反贪委审查阶段，可能引发广泛人事变动。
desc_original: Police submitted their investigation file on fraud in local government recruitment examinations to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) within the required 30-day deadline, says national police chief Pol Gen Samran Nualma.

title: Plans for common ticketing system speed up
desc: The Transport Ministry is accelerating plans to introduce a common ticketing system for Bangkok's electric rail network on Jan 1, 2027, allowing passengers to change lines without paying a second entry fee and capping fares at 45 baht per trip.
title_cn: 曼谷轨道交通统一售票系统加速推进
summary_cn: 泰国交通运输部加速推进曼谷电气化轨道交通统一售票系统建设，计划2027年1月1日实施。新系统允许乘客换线无需额外付费，单程票价统一上限45泰铢。这一改革将大幅便利曼谷居民和游客出行，显著降低交通成本，提升公共交通竞争力。
desc_original: The Transport Ministry is accelerating plans to introduce a common ticketing system for Bangkok's electric rail network on Jan 1, 2027, allowing passengers to change lines without paying a second entry fee and capping fares at 45 baht per trip.

title: Govt figures unfazed by debate plan
desc: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas on Saturday brushed aside concerns after being named in the planned no-confidence debate, saying he had done nothing wrong as an official.
title_cn: 财政部长对不信任案辩论计划不为所动
summary_cn: 泰国财政部长埃克尼迪·尼迪坦普拉帕萨回应了即将举行的不信任案辩论计划，声称自己作为官员已尽忠职守，否认任何不当行为。此事反映了泰国政府与反对派之间的政治对峙，可能影响政府稳定性和政策推进。
desc_original: Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas on Saturday brushed aside concerns after being named in the planned no-confidence debate, saying he had done nothing wrong as an official.

title: Public invited to join IMF-World Bank town hall
desc: The government is inviting the public to follow the International Monetary Fund (IMF)-World Bank meetings online from Monday and submit questions during a "Town Hall” session.
title_cn: 政府邀请公众参与国际货币基金组织与世界银行线上论坛
summary_cn: 泰国政府邀请公众在线参与国际货币基金组织(IMF)与世界银行的联合会议，可在论坛环节提交问题。活动从周一启动，旨在增进公众对国际金融机构政策的了解。此举反映泰国对国际经济合作的重视，外国居民可关注国家经济政策动向。
desc_original: The government is inviting the public to follow the International Monetary Fund (IMF)-World Bank meetings online from Monday and submit questions during a "Town Hall” session.

title: Thai PBS funding in spotlight
desc: A proposal by the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) to amend laws governing four public bodies has sparked debate over their funding and accountability.
title_cn: 泰国公共广播电视网资金与问责制引发争议
summary_cn: 执政党为民党(Bhumjaithai Party, BJT)提议修改管制公共广播电视网等四个公共机构的法律，在各界引发关于资金管理与问责机制的激烈辩论。此举关乎泰国媒体透明度与独立性，可能影响公众信息获取与新闻自由度。
desc_original: A proposal by the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) to amend laws governing four public bodies has sparked debate over their funding and accountability.

title: Anutin orders NBTC to explain chairman's meeting notices
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) to explain why its chairman continues to convene board meetings despite a court ruling concerning his eligibility to hold office.
title_cn: 总理责令电信委解释主席续任会议事宜
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·查隆威拉库尔(Anutin Charnvirakul)下令国家广播与电信委员会(NBTC)对其主席继续主持会议一事做出说明。尽管法院对该主席任职资格提出质疑，他仍在继续行使权力。此事反映泰国权力制衡机制的问题，涉及司法权威与行政权力的冲突。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) to explain why its chairman continues to convene board meetings despite a court ruling concerning his eligibility to hold office.

title: เงินเยียวยาน้ำท่วม 2569 ยอดโอนพุ่งต่อเนื่อง จ่ายเงินสำเร็จแล้ว 31 จังหวัด

title_cn: 2026年洪灾救济金发放持续推进 已覆盖31个府
summary_cn: 泰国政府与储蓄银行(Government Savings Bank)继续加快洪灾救济资金发放，最新一轮已向75326户受灾家庭转账超过6.5亿泰铢，覆盖全国31个府。这是政府对水灾受害者的直接经济援助，直接关系在泰外国人及其家庭的生命财产安全。

Lieutenant General Phet-ek Intharat, deputy director of the Bangkok ISOC for military affairs, assigned Intelligence Collection and Verification Unit 101 to join the inspection. Two of the four parcels came from Germany. The first contained 97 ecstasy pills, including broken fragments. They were described as three layer tablets in blue, pink and grey, alongside grey, green and blue pills. The second German parcel held 94 white alprazolam pills, also including broken fragments. title: Tourist Police ask the Russian embassy to brief visitors
desc: Tourist Police ask the Russian embassy to brief visitors Legacy The Tourist Police have asked the Russian Embassy to help brief Russian visitors on Thai laws , local customs and conduct to avoid, as the two sides discuss closer cooperation on tourist safety . Tourist Police Commander Pol Lt Gen Pongsiam Meekanthong met Russian Ambassador Evgeny Tomikhin at the embassy in Bangkok at 11am on October 7. The meeting gave the newly appointed Tourist Police chief a chance to open talks with the Russian diplomatic mission. Pongsiam and Tomikhin discussed ways to improve security and assistance for Russian tourists and Russians living in Thailand, as well as issues involving Russians working in the country. Pongsiam asked the embassy to pass key information to Russians already in Thailand and those planning trips. This covers Thai laws and regulations, local customs and practices, and activities visitors should avoid. The Tourist Police said the aim is to help Russian visitors understand their responsibilities and cut down on problems caused by misunderstandings of local laws and customs. title: 193 Thais deported from Cambodia, 18 wanted for scams
desc: 193 Thais deported from Cambodia, 18 wanted for scams Legacy Sa Kaeo immigration police received 193 Thais deported by Cambodia at the Ban Khlong Luek permanent border checkpoint in Aranyaprathet district on October 8. Cyber police later found that 18 of them have arrest warrants linked to call centre gangs. The group had been detained during a Cambodian crackdown on transnational online scam networks and call centre gangs, before the Cambodian government sent them back to Thailand. Pol Col Rung Thongmon, chief of Sa Kaeo immigration police, said the handover followed the National Referral Mechanism (NRM), a screening process used to identify who was deceived or forced into scam work and who joined voluntarily. Rung said those found to be victims will be cared for as human trafficking victims, while anyone who took part willingly will be prosecuted. Officers checked criminal records, separated the returnees into groups and provided support to young people and women. Rung said the process followed principles of human rights, safety and dignity. desc: Chiang Rai network sold Thai ID cards to foreigners Legacy The Department of Provincial Administration (DOPA) has exposed four cases of household registration fraud in Chiang Rai, including two Chinese men wanted on INTERPOL red notices who obtained Thai identity documents. The cases are part of Operation Northern Shadow, which targets transnational criminal networks that exploit loopholes in Thailand’s civil registration system. Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit presided over the briefing at Wang Thonglang Police Station in Bangkok at 11am on 9 October 2026. Worasit said the investigation is widening to three groups: people who fraudulently took over registration rights, brokers who arranged the records, and officials who may have been involved. title: 护民众促发展，泰国推进数据中心环境标准草案
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月9日，泰国自然资源与环境部部长素查在主持数据中心业务政策委员会下属环境小组委员会第1/2569次会议后表示，目前，数据中心业务呈持续扩张趋势，且对国家数字经济具有重要作用，所以其投资促进必须与自然资源、环境和民众生活质量保障同步推进。 本次会议重点审议了《数据中心经营者行为准则》草案，旨在预防和减少环境影响，例如规定经营者必须重视“最低措施”，包括用电、用水、环境管理，以及备用燃油的储存与管理等，确保数据中心业务标准、谨慎，同时能有效控制其对环境与民众的潜在风险。 推进数据中心对经济和国家发展至关重要，但增长必须与对环境的责任同步。因此，从一开始就应该明确标准，让民众放心，经济发展不会给自然资源和环境带来负担。另外，也必须明确运营方向，如数据中心的规模等，始终以民众为重，加强沟通，消除民众担忧，必要时与相关机构协调，安排负责环境监测的公共部门向民众说明。在细节方面要周密考虑，既为投资者提供框架，也不阻碍投资和国家整体经济增长。 素查指出，《数据中心经营者行为准则》草案将作为预防和减少数据中心业务环境影响的重要框架，会议收集了相关部门和各领域专家的意见和建议，后续将进一步完善草案，使其更全面、更可行。自然资源与环境部将全力履行监管职责，确保泰国数据中心高质量、环保式发展，并与社区可持续共存。待本草案完善后，将提交数据中心业务政策委员会审议，接着进入下一步程序。 （编译：KA；来源：matichon） The post 护民众促发展，泰国推进数据中心环境标准草案 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Suvarnabhumi signs a third ground handler
desc: Suvarnabhumi signs a third ground handler Legacy Airports of Thailand (AOT) has signed a 25 year contract with a third ground handling and cargo operator at Suvarnabhumi Airport, following a baggage backlog and flight delays involving Thai Airways. AOT and Airports of Thailand Ground Aviation Services (AOTGA) signed the public-private partnership deal on 8 October. It covers ground support equipment, ramp and passenger handling, and a new cargo warehouse service at the airport. AOTGA will start ground services in 2027 and needs about 23 months to build and prepare the cargo facilities. The contract includes KPIs for service performance, with penalties and fines if AOTGA fails to meet them. Pawina Jariyathitipong, AOT president, signed for the airport operator, and Siriwat Tovajirakul, AOTGA general manager, signed for the company. Sirote Duangrat, AOT deputy president for business development and marketing, and General Supawat Cherdtham, AOTGA chairman, attended as witnesses. AOT said the deal follows Section 36 of the Public-Private Partnership Act 2019. The Cabinet approved the selection result and key contract terms on 8 September, as proposed by the Transport Ministry. AOT said

title: 泰国携手谷歌升级TH-AI Passport，开放50万个免费名额
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月9日，泰国数字经济与社会部次长帕查宣布，TH-AI Passport项目将进一步升级为AiPASS 2.0，并携手谷歌提供50万个Gemini Enterprise名额，分配给在AiPASS平台累计积分达到1000分的学员，以支持其将AI真正应用到实际工作中，最长可免费使用10个月。 国家数字经济与社会委员会秘书韦坦透露，TH-AI Passport项目旨在提升泰国人的数字与人工智能技能，此次与谷歌的合作源于用户希望AI能帮助他们完成多步骤的连续工作。AiPASS x Gemini Enterprise是谷歌的一个人工智能代理（AI Agents）平台，可连接邮箱、日历和工作文件，协助用户总结文档、管理邮件、处理大量数据，以及生成图片和视频，目标是让学员从“学习使用AI”迈入“将AI应用到工作中”。 谷歌云泰国区经理Saruj Thipsena表示，这次合作将把代理式人工智能（Agentic AI）的潜力带给泰国民众，为实际动手工作的AI应用做好准备，并为泰国的经济创造附加价值。 国家数字经济与社会委员会指出，自TH-AI Passport项目启动以来，截至2026年10月8日16点30分，注册人数已超过157万，其中前100万人是在前两天内完成的注册，约七分之一的注册者为自由职业者和企业主。在学习方面，用户完成课程和知识视频共计313万次，课程完成率达73%，已发放证书250353份。完成课程的学员中，有22%年龄在55岁以上。在AI工具使用方面，累计约有74.5万人使用，通过指令或提示词辅助工作和学习超1730万次，涵盖对话、编写代码、数据分析、生成图片、生成视频和深度研究等，涉及来自14家厂商的30多个AI模型。在用户自行选择模型的指令中，约四分之三选择了高级模型，这类模型通常需要付费才能使用。 下一阶段，委员会规划了三个级别的AI技能发展路径，以便学员使用适合自己的工具： -入门级：AiPASS将30多个主流AI模型整合在一个平台，新增自动选择模型（Auto Model）功能，以及生成Word和Excel文件功能，并持续更新模型； -中级：AiPASS与Gemini Enterprise结合，通过连接邮箱、日历和工作文件，让AI Agent帮助完成连续工作；累计积分达到1000分的学员可从2026年10月9日至11月2日（或名额用完为止）申请使用权，并于2026年11月9日开始使用； -开发者级：AiPASS x Developer Rout计划于2027年1月启动，届时将开放开发者API，并在各地区举办训练营，以支持与全球合作伙伴共同开发解决方案。 （编译：KA；来源：thestandard） The post 泰国携手谷歌升级TH-AI Passport，开放50万个免费名额 appeared first on 泰国头条新

title: Chon Buri police raid suspected Chinese nominee metal company
desc: Chon Buri police raid suspected Chinese nominee metal company Legacy Police in Chon Buri raided a metal company in Ban Bueng district on Thursday, 8 October, over suspicions it was operating through a Chinese nominee arrangement, and arrested a Chinese man already wanted by a court. Ban Bueng Police Station led the operation with Chon Buri Immigration, the Ban Bueng district administration office and the Chon Buri Provincial Commerce Office. Officers searched the company in Moo 1, Nong Sam Sak subdistrict, between 8am and 12pm. The search was carried out under a Chon Buri Provincial Court warrant. Officers seized documents that police said were evidence of the alleged offences. During the raid, officers found Xiaopo Hao, who was wanted under a separate Chon Buri Provincial Court arrest warrant. Police allege that Xiaopo, as a foreigner, let Thai nationals hold shares in a limited company on his behalf so he could run a business while avoiding the Foreign Business Act. He was also charged with operating a business as a foreigner in breach of Section 8(3) of the act. Officers told him the charges and his rights, then took him to Ban Bueng Police Station for further legal action. Nomi

title: AI initiative targets 3m users this year
desc: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry wants to increase the number of TH-AI Passport registrants to 3 million by year-end, nearly doubling the current 1.57 million, with participation by businesses nationwide expected to help drive adoption.
title_cn: AI计划年底前目标新增300万用户
summary_cn: 泰国数字经济与社会部（DES）计划在年底前将「TH-AI护照」用户数增至300万，较现有157万用户几乎翻倍。该部门寄望全国企业的参与能够推动用户采纳和普及。AI护照是泰国推进数字身份和数字经济的重要举措。
desc_original: The Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry wants to increase the number of TH-AI Passport registrants to 3 million by year-end, nearly doubling the current 1.57 million, with participation by businesses nationwide expected to help drive adoption.

title: Car production to restart next week after flood delays
desc: Flood-hit car manufacturers in Thailand's eastern region are preparing to resume production from Oct 14 as auto parts suppliers recover from severe flooding that disrupted the supply chain, according to the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI).
title_cn: 泰国汽车产业洪灾后下周重启生产
summary_cn: 泰国东部汽车制造商因洪灾停产，零部件供应链遭严重中断。据泰国工业联合会（FTI）报告，随着零部件供应商逐步复苏，各大车厂已做好准备，计划于10月14日启动生产复工。此次复工标志着该地区汽车制造业自灾害以来的首次大规模重启，有助于加快产业链恢复正常运营，对泰国经济稳定有重要意义。
desc_original: Flood-hit car manufacturers in Thailand's eastern region are preparing to resume production from Oct 14 as auto parts suppliers recover from severe flooding that disrupted the supply chain, according to the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI).

title: Krabi eyes boost from Russian tourists
desc: Nine charter flights linking Krabi to four Russian cities this month will boost tourism and strengthen its role as a gateway to the Andaman coast, Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit said.
title_cn: 甲米开通俄罗斯包机航线扩展旅游市场
summary_cn: 甲米将在本月新增九条包机航线，直连俄罗斯四个主要城市，进一步巩固其作为安达曼海岸门户的地位。副运输部长帕塔蓬·帕塔拉拉西（Phattrapong Phattraprasit）表示，这一举措将有力推动甲米旅游业增长，吸引更多俄罗斯游客到访。包机航线的开通反映了泰国与俄罗斯旅游合作的深化，预计为当地经济、酒店及相关行业带来显著增长机遇。
desc_original: Nine charter flights linking Krabi to four Russian cities this month will boost tourism and strengthen its role as a gateway to the Andaman coast, Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit said.

title: City tops UK readers' poll
desc: Bangkok has been named the world's best city for 2026, topping Condé Nast Traveller's UK Readers' Choice Awards and winning over UK travellers.
title_cn: 曼谷荣膺2026年度全球最佳城市
summary_cn: 曼谷在权威旅游媒体《康泰纳仕旅行者》英国版2026年度「最佳城市」读者投票中胜出，被评为全球最佳城市。这一荣誉充分肯定了曼谷作为东南亚首选旅游目的地的国际地位和吸引力。此项殊荣将进一步提升曼谷在全球游客心中的品牌价值，对泰国旅游业和当地经济发展具有重要推动作用，预计将吸引更多国际游客到访。
desc_original: Bangkok has been named the world's best city for 2026, topping Condé Nast Traveller's UK Readers' Choice Awards and winning over UK travellers.

title: Thai PBS seeks  audit clarification
desc: Thai Public Broadcasting Service (Thai PBS) has clarified that it has not received any official audit findings from the State Audit Office (SAO) regarding reports that 10 executives and employees were ordered to pay 85.22 million baht in damages to the state.
title_cn: 泰国PBS就巨额赔偿通知寻求审计澄清
summary_cn: 泰国公共广播服务公司对外澄清，目前尚未从国家审计办公室（SAO）收到任何正式审计调查结果通知。此前媒体报道称该公司十名高管及员工被责令向国家赔偿8522万泰铢，引发广泛关注。该公司已与相关部门沟通，力求获得官方澄清文件，以便核实指控内容、了解具体责任情况，并制定相应回应方案。
desc_original: Thai Public Broadcasting Service (Thai PBS) has clarified that it has not received any official audit findings from the State Audit Office (SAO) regarding reports that 10 executives and employees were ordered to pay 85.22 million baht in damages to the state.

title: Suphajee backs B450 tourism fee plan
desc: Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun has backed a proposal to impose a 450-baht tourism fee on foreign visitors.
title_cn: 商务部长力挺450泰铢旅游入境费方案
summary_cn: 泰国商务部长苏帕杰·素统蓬（Suphajee Suthumpun）公开支持对外国游客征收450泰铢旅游费的提案。该费用制度拟用于增加政府旅游基金收入，用于景点设施改善及旅游管理服务升级。此政策若最终实施，将直接增加赴泰外国游客的消费成本，需要游客在入境时或购票时额外支付，对游客预算和旅游决策带来直接影响。
desc_original: Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun has backed a proposal to impose a 450-baht tourism fee on foreign visitors.

title: Tourism firms baulk at allocation of arrival fee
desc: Tourism operators do not want the 450-baht tourism tax to fund travel insurance for all foreign visitors, arguing that past unpaid medical bills were more likely incurred by foreign workers than tourists, making the scheme unfair to genuine travellers.
title_cn: 旅游业者反对入国税用于游客保险补贴
summary_cn: 泰国旅游业者反对将450泰铢入国税用于为全体外国游客提供旅行保险。业者认为该方案不公平，指出过往未付医疗账单主要由外国劳工积欠，而非游客所为，此举应区分两类群体，不应让真正游客为他人账单埋单。
desc_original: Tourism operators do not want the 450-baht tourism tax to fund travel insurance for all foreign visitors, arguing that past unpaid medical bills were more likely incurred by foreign workers than tourists, making the scheme unfair to genuine travellers.

title: Ekniti welcomes IMF boost
desc: Hosting the IMF-World Bank 2026 Meetings will help enhance Thailand's image and strengthen its reputation as a world-class destination, says Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.
title_cn: 埃克尼蒂欢迎IMF-世界银行会议落地泰国
summary_cn: 泰国副总理兼财长埃克尼蒂（Ekniti Nitithanprapas）表示，泰国主办2026年国际货币基金组织（IMF）与世界银行联合年会，将显著增强国家国际形象、巩固其作为世界级目的地的声誉。此举对泰国经济和国际地位具有重要意义。
desc_original: Hosting the IMF-World Bank 2026 Meetings will help enhance Thailand's image and strengthen its reputation as a world-class destination, says Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

title: Police widen probe into suspect IDs
desc: Police are investigating four key suspects in an alleged civil registration fraud network in Chiang Rai, including a Chinese man whose bank accounts and his wife's recorded combined transactions of about 581 million baht.
title_cn: 清莱警方扩大身份登记欺诈案调查
summary_cn: 泰国警方在清莱省（Chiang Rai）侦破一起涉嫌民事登记欺诈网络案，四名关键嫌疑人遭调查，其中一名中籍嫌疑人及其妻子的银行账户合并交易额达5.81亿泰铢。案件规模庞大，涉及身份欺诈，警方已扩大调查范围。
desc_original: Police are investigating four key suspects in an alleged civil registration fraud network in Chiang Rai, including a Chinese man whose bank accounts and his wife's recorded combined transactions of about 581 million baht.

title: Anutin ready for censure
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed concerns over an opposition no-confidence motion targeting 18 cabinet ministers, saying the government is ready to answer allegations and explain its performance to the public.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷表示已做好应对不信任投票准备
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）对反对党提交针对18名内阁部长的不信任动议表示毫不畏惧，称政府已做好充分准备，将对所有指控进行坦诚答辩并向公众说明执政成绩，显示对政府施政的信心。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed concerns over an opposition no-confidence motion targeting 18 cabinet ministers, saying the government is ready to answer allegations and explain its performance to the public.

title: Ex-PTTEP exec returned in 'Rolls' case
desc: A former executive of PTT Exploration and Production Plc (PTTEP), accused in a transnational bribery case involving Rolls-Royce, has been brought back to Thailand from Indonesia to face prosecution.
title_cn: 前PTTEP高管因劳斯莱斯贿赂案被遣返泰国
summary_cn: 泰国石油勘探生产公司（PTTEP）前高管因涉嫌与英国劳斯莱斯公司（Rolls-Royce）跨国贿赂案被控，已从印度尼西亚被遣返泰国接受起诉。此案涉及国际商业贿赂，性质严重，反映对企业廉政的查处力度。
desc_original: A former executive of PTT Exploration and Production Plc (PTTEP), accused in a transnational bribery case involving Rolls-Royce, has been brought back to Thailand from Indonesia to face prosecution.

title: Banks use buffers to absorb shocks
desc: Household borrowers are likely to be more severely affected by ongoing flooding than businesses, while banks have strengthened their business continuity plans (BCPs) to prepare for a wider range of unexpected events.
title_cn: 银行设缓冲机制应对风险冲击
summary_cn: 泰国暴雨洪灾期间，个人借贷者所受冲击比企业更严重。各银行已加强业务连续性计划，强化对突发事件的应对能力。金融机构通过建立缓冲机制来吸收外部冲击，进一步保护客户利益和金融系统稳定。
desc_original: Household borrowers are likely to be more severely affected by ongoing flooding than businesses, while banks have strengthened their business continuity plans (BCPs) to prepare for a wider range of unexpected events.

summary_cn: 库纳迪普·松达瑞克（绰号「高尔夫」）出身泰国南部合艾县（Hatyai），少年时每天需坐车20公里才能进城读书。后来登火车赴曼谷追梦，历经奋斗蜕变成「世界学生」，最终创办了ANGKRIZ事业。这是一个从乡村少年到国际企业家的励志传记。

title: Govt seeks opportunities with EU, UAE
desc: The government is seeking to expand trade opportunities in Europe and the Middle East through agreements with the European Union (EU) and the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
title_cn: 泰国政府与欧盟、阿联酋拓展贸易合作
summary_cn: 泰国政府正积极与欧盟（EU）和阿联酋（UAE）谈判，开拓欧洲和中东市场的贸易机会。这是泰国外交经济战略的重要举措，旨在多元化出口市场、深化区域经济合作、促进长期经济增长。
desc_original: The government is seeking to expand trade opportunities in Europe and the Middle East through agreements with the European Union (EU) and the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

title: Police chief sets hard line on drugs, scams
desc: National police chief Pol Gen Samran Nuanma yesterday named tougher action on drug trafficking, nominee businesses, scam networks and corruption as the force's urgent priorities for fiscal 2027.
title_cn: 警察局长宣布严打毒品犯罪和诈骗活动
summary_cn: 泰国国家警察局长萨兰·努安玛宣布，2027财政年度将把打击毒品贩运、皮包公司、诈骗网络和腐败犯罪列为紧急优先事项。警方将采取更强硬态度，严厉打击跨境毒品走私、网络诈骗分子和腐败现象，维护社会治安和人民财产安全。
desc_original: National police chief Pol Gen Samran Nuanma yesterday named tougher action on drug trafficking, nominee businesses, scam networks and corruption as the force's urgent priorities for fiscal 2027.

title: High‑tech industries  to shift labour force
desc: New investments promising to create jobs may not always deliver broad employment opportunities in Thailand, warns Tanit Sorat, vice‑chairman of the Employers' Confederation of Thai Trade and Industry.
title_cn: 高科技产业劳动力配置转变
summary_cn: 泰国雇主协会副主席 Tanit Sorat 警告，虽然新的投资项目承诺创造就业机会，但这些新投资可能无法为泰国广泛创造就业机会。反映出产业升级可能带来的结构性就业挑战。
desc_original: New investments promising to create jobs may not always deliver broad employment opportunities in Thailand, warns Tanit Sorat, vice‑chairman of the Employers' Confederation of Thai Trade and Industry.

title: Chinese music teacher returns home safely after IP address appears in Myanmar
desc: Chinese music teacher returns home safely after IP address appears in Myanmar Legacy A 33 year old Chinese music teacher who lost contact with his family while travelling in Bangkok returned safely to Shanghai . The circumstances surrounding his disappearance have not been disclosed. Wang Qi travelled alone from Shanghai to Bangkok on September 24. title: 泰国迎来国际外交盛事！瑞士联邦主席、新加坡总统将先后访泰
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 近日，泰国外交部发布官方通报，公布2026年国际货币基金组织（IMF）与世界银行集团年会期间外国领导人访泰相关安排。本次年会定于2026年10月12日至18日在泰国举办，瑞士联邦主席、新加坡总统将先后对泰国开展正式访问。 据泰国外交部信息司司长、外交部发言人柴泰介绍，此次是泰国第二次承办IMF与世行联合年会，泰国也跻身全球仅有的三个两次主办该国际会议的国家之列。本次年会规模盛大，预计将汇聚全球190余个国家的代表，参会总人数超1.5万人，同时将有千余名媒体记者赴泰开展报道工作。 根据官方公布的行程安排，瑞士联邦主席居伊·帕姆兰将携夫人以泰国政府贵宾身份对泰进行正式访问，并率领商界代表团随行出访。此次访问是瑞士联邦主席时隔22年再度访泰，且2026年恰逢泰国与瑞士建交95周年，访问具备特殊纪念意义与合作价值。 柴泰表示，瑞士是泰国的重要合作伙伴，双边经贸与人文合作基础深厚。在欧洲区域，瑞士是泰国第二大贸易伙伴，同时也是泰国在欧洲自由贸易联盟成员国中的第一大贸易伙伴。此外，瑞士是泰国重要的外资来源地，目前已有超150家瑞士企业落地泰国投资兴业；泰国亦有约3.6万名民众定居瑞士，人文交流往来密切。 同期，新加坡总统尚达曼也将以泰国政府贵宾身份对泰开展正式访问。访泰期间，泰国总理阿努廷将在政府大楼会见尚达曼，尚达曼还将前往安蓬萨坦皇家宫殿，觐见泰国国王玛哈· 哇集拉隆功陛下、王后素提达殿下。 泰国外交部评价，新加坡是泰国多领域核心战略合作伙伴，两国在可持续绿色发展、粮食安全、经济互联互通、数字经济、创新技术等重点领域合作紧密、成果丰硕。同时，新加坡长期位居泰国外资来源国首位，是泰国最重要的经贸合作伙伴之一。 泰国外交部表示，瑞士、新加坡两国元首访泰的具体行程细节及访问成果，将在后续适时对外公布。 为配套本次IMF与世行年会举办，泰国还将策划开展多场专题配套活动，聚焦区域可持续发展、经济转型升级、基础设施建设等核心议题，具体安排如下： 专题圆桌会议：加强东盟韧性与新兴发展伙伴的作用，共创更安全、可持续的未来 英文主题：Strengthening ASEAN Resilience and the Role of Emerging Development Partners for a More Secure and Sustainable Future 本次圆桌会议由泰国外交部联合泰国邻国经济发展合作局（NEDA）共同主办，将于2026年10月9日在曼谷都喜天丽酒店举办。会议将邀请泰国、老挝、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、日本的国际发展合作机构代表参会，重点围绕三方合作机制赋能东盟发展、提升区域风险应对能力、助力全球可持续发展目标落地等议题展开深入研讨。会议秉持以人为本的发展理念，坚守“不让任何一个人掉队”的发展原则，聚焦东盟区域协同发展与韧性提升。 二、主题晚

title: Five Hua Hin-area hotels recognised among 71 across Thailand
desc: Five Hua Hin-area hotels recognised among 71 across Thailand Legacy Five hotels in and around Hua Hin have been recognised in the Michelin Guide’s 2026 hotel selection , with two properties receiving the distinction for the first time as Thailand’s total number of recognised hotels increases to 71. The results, announced previously on September 18, highlight the coastal destination’s presence in the country’s hospitality sector. All five properties received One Michelin Key, which is awarded to hotels offering what Michelin describes as a very special stay. The number of Hua Hin Michelin Key hotels has increased as part of a wider expansion of the awards across Thailand, with the national total rising from 62 properties in 2025 to 71 this year. The 2026 selection includes six Three-Key hotels, 22 Two-Key hotels and 43 One-Key hotels. Among the two newcomers are Chiva-Som Hua Hin, a wellness retreat , and Devasom Hua Hin, a boutique beachfront resort near Cha-am. Both were included in the Michelin Key selection for the first time. They join three previously recognised properties: Anantara Hua Hin Resort & Spa, V Villas Hua Hin and Aleenta Resort & Spa

title_cn: 泰国政府启动洪灾救济金发放
summary_cn: 泰国政府已开始发放首批洪灾救济金。灾难预防与减灾部门表示，超过142万户家庭通过Tang Rat应用程序注册申请救济。政府通过该应用平台推进救济发放工作，旨在为洪灾受害者提供及时的财政支援，帮助灾区居民尽快恢复正常生活。
desc_original: Authorities on Thursday began transferring the first flood relief payments, as more than 1.42 million households have registered for assistance through the Tang Rat app, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) said.

title: MRTA opens properties to investment
desc: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to develop nearly 70 sites to generate more revenue and make better use of its land, with the first major project planned for the Rama IX area.
title_cn: 曼谷捷运局开放70个地块投资开发
summary_cn: 泰国大众快速运输局（MRTA）计划开发近70个地块以增加收入，并更好地利用其地产资源。首个重大项目位于拉玛九世（Rama IX）地区。此举将为投资者创造商业机会，同时增加公共运输部门的财政收入，推动曼谷的房地产和基础设施发展。
desc_original: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to develop nearly 70 sites to generate more revenue and make better use of its land, with the first major project planned for the Rama IX area.

title: Govt defends  transfer of district chief
desc: Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee has defended the transfer of Ban Sang district chief Setthawut Wonglerwut, saying the decision was based on reports from provincial officials and local leaders rather than political pressure.
title_cn: 政府为班桑县县长调任辩护
summary_cn: 泰国副内政部长普拉佩·苏温楚威为班桑县（Ban Sang）县长塞塔武特·翁勒卖的调任辩护，强调该决定基于省级官员和地方领导人的报告，而非政治压力。
desc_original: Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee has defended the transfer of Ban Sang district chief Setthawut Wonglerwut, saying the decision was based on reports from provincial officials and local leaders rather than political pressure.

title: Working groups to draw up 'open government' plans
desc: Four working groups will develop proposals on corruption, environmental problems, public participation and access to justice as Thailand works on its next national action plan for open government.
title_cn: 泰国组建工作组制定「开放政府」计划
summary_cn: 泰国成立四个工作小组，分别针对腐败、环保问题、公众参与和司法正义四个领域制定建议书，为制定下一阶段国家开放政府行动计划做准备，推进政府透明度和问责制建设。
desc_original: Four working groups will develop proposals on corruption, environmental problems, public participation and access to justice as Thailand works on its next national action plan for open government.

title: Sri Lanka woos Thais ahead of 2027 expo
desc: Sri Lanka is seeking Thai investment and business partnerships in sectors ranging from food and manufacturing to technology, tourism and healthcare as it prepares for Sri Lanka Expo 2027 in Colombo.

title: Thailand weather today, 9 October: heavy rain in 16 provinces, Bangkok a few showers
desc: Thailand weather today, 9 October: heavy rain in 16 provinces, Bangkok a few showers Legacy The Thai Meteorological Department forecasts heavy rain in 16 provinces today, with the Northeast, East and South hit hardest. Amnat Charoen, Bueng Kan, Nakhon Phanom, Si Sa Ket, Surin and Ubon Ratchathani face isolated heavy rain, along with Chanthaburi and Trat in the East. The South also sees heavy rain across Nakhon Si Thammarat, Narathiwat, Phatthalung, Phetchaburi, Prachuap Khiri Khan, Songkhla, Surat Thani and Yala. Bangkok can expect isolated thundershowers, with lows of 25°C and highs of 35°C. Residents in affected areas are warned of flash floods and overflows, particularly along waterways near foothills and in low-lying land. A high-pressure system covers the upper North and upper Northeast. Southeasterly winds carry moisture from the South China Sea into the eastern Northeast and the East. A monsoon trough lies across the Gulf and the South, driving the wet conditions there. Bangkok The capital sees isolated thundershowers through the forecast period. Lows of 25°C and highs of 35°C are expected, with northeasterly winds of 10 to 20km/h. North Isolated thundershowers are forecast

title: Thai candy floss wrapped mid-flight draws Peking duck jokes
desc: Thai candy floss wrapped mid-flight draws Peking duck jokes Legacy A passenger enjoying Thailand’s traditional sweet treat , roti sai mai, during a flight has attracted attention online after another traveller jokingly compared the dessert to Peking duck wraps . The encounter was shared on Threads on October 5 by a model using the account @runqianlin , who filmed a fellow passenger preparing the snack on board an aircraft. In a Chinese-language caption, the model joked that someone appeared to be rolling Peking duck wraps during the flight and asked whether they could have some. However, the passenger was not preparing the famous Chinese dish. The food appeared to be roti sai mai, a traditional Thai dessert made by wrapping fine strands of spun sugar in thin, soft roti sheets. The footage showed the passenger handling a pale green roti sheet with candy floss in the middle, ready to be rolled and eaten. title: 2 Thai men arrested after body found in burned pickup in Trang
desc: 2 Thai men arrested after body found in burned pickup in Trang Legacy Police in Trang arrested two Thai men after a man was found dead inside a burned-out pickup truck near Tha Ngio Reservoir in Huai Yot district. The case is linked to a dispute over a drug deal. Firefighters were called to a roadside forest near the reservoir on the night of October 6 after a pickup truck was found on fire. Once the fire was extinguished, firefighters discovered human remains inside the vehicle. A Thai woman, Siriluck, contacted Huai Yot Police Station after seeing a rescue foundation post and a news report showing the vehicle’s registration. She believed the deceased was her 37 year old brother, Theerasak, from Sichon district in Nakhon Si Thammarat. Siriluck said she had been unable to contact her brother for several days. She said Theerasak worked tapping rubber with his partner and travelled between Bang Klam and Sichon, where their mother lived alone following their father’s death. She said she could not understand why her brother would have gone to the reservoir. desc: Phuket rider says hotel staff eat food delivered to foreign guest at reception Legacy A food delivery rider in Phuket filed a police complaint, alleging that hotel staff took and ate fried chicken he had delivered for a foreign guest. The rider, who has not been identified, shared his account with the Phuket Times Facebook page on October 7. He also did not disclose the name of the hotel involved. According to the rider, he accepted an order for fried chicken and left the food at the hotel’s reception counter. He said delivery riders were normally instructed to leave food at reception rather than taking orders directly to guests’ rooms. The rider said he left the hotel to collect his next delivery. He later received a complaint from the customer through the delivery application’s reporting system, stating that the food had not arrived. title: Bangkok readies flood defences for IMF-World Bank meetings
desc: Bangkok readies flood defences for IMF-World Bank meetings Legacy Bangkok is preparing drainage crews, mobile pumps and emergency response measures around venues for the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings 2026 from October 12 to 16. Surapong Sarapa, director of the Meteorological Department’s Weather Forecast Division, said yesterday, October 7, that weather conditions would remain unsettled on October 10 and 11 as Thailand moves from the end of the rainy season into the start of winter. Rainfall during those two days is expected to reach around 30 to 50 millimetres, with periods of heavy rain lasting for relatively short periods. Surapong said rainfall should then return to more normal levels during the period covering the IMF-World Bank meetings. Bangkok’s Department of Drainage and Sewerage has prepared additional flood prevention measures around the meeting area. Photo via Ministry of Finance The department said water from roads would be pumped directly into Saen Saep Canal before being discharged through Khlong Tan and Phadung Krung Kasem Canal into the Chao Phraya River. Water collection facilities surrounding the meeting area will also be used to pump water from Saen Saep Canal

summary_cn: 泰国近期洪灾预计将对第四季度国内汽车销售造成轻微影响。消费者因灾情延迟购车计划，汽车经销商面临交付延误问题。根据泰国马自达销售公司预测，灾害天气状况将持续对车市购销活动构成压力。

summary_cn: 泰国财政部正起草新的投资促进法，拟用以替代泰国工业委员会（Board of Investment，BoI）目前实施的税收优惠政策。新法案旨在创新投资激励机制，为国内外投资者提供更优化的政策环境，进一步推动泰国经济投资吸引力。
desc_original: The Revenue Department is drafting a new investment promotion law to replace the tax incentives currently provided by the Board of Investment (BoI).

desc: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) index is expected to finish at 1,680 points by year-end, supported by investment in artificial intelligence (AI) technology and its supply chain, listed-company earnings, foreign fund inflows and a recovery in the domestic economy, says the Investment Analysts Association (IAA).

summary_cn: 泰国投资分析师协会预测，证券交易所（SET）指数有望在今年年底达到1680点。市场支撑因素包括人工智能及其供应链领域的投资增加、上市公司业绩改善、外资基金持续流入以及国内经济复苏。

desc: The insurance industry is reporting more complex cyberthreats powered by artificial intelligence (AI), prompting the Office of the Insurance Commission (OIC) to join hands with 67 life and non-life insurers to strengthen cyber-resilience, from prevention and response to recovery.

summary_cn: 泰国保险业面临人工智能驱动的复杂网络威胁。保险监管委员会（OIC）联合67家寿险及产险公司，从预防、应对到恢复等全环节强化网络防护能力，提升行业网络韧性。

title: Oil Fuel Fund mulls loan options
desc: The Energy Ministry has stressed that borrowing money from banks to shore up the loss-riddled Oil Fuel Fund is a last resort, despite the fund's deficit approaching 100 billion baht.
title_cn: 石油燃料基金探索银行融资方案
summary_cn: 泰国石油燃料基金长期亏损，赤字已接近100亿泰铢。能源部强调向银行借贷是最后手段，基金面临严峻财务困难。政府正研究其他救助融资方案以度过难关。
desc_original: The Energy Ministry has stressed that borrowing money from banks to shore up the loss-riddled Oil Fuel Fund is a last resort, despite the fund's deficit approaching 100 billion baht.

title: Panel seeks to beef up flood preparedness
desc: A private sector panel is preparing a letter to the prime minister urging the government to accelerate efforts to strengthen Thailand's preparedness for future flooding.
title_cn: 民营部门敦促政府加强防洪准备工作
summary_cn: 泰国民营部门正准备致函总理，敦促政府加速推进防洪准备工作。近期严重洪灾凸显国家防灾体系薄弱，业界呼吁政府采取更有力、更前瞻的防灾措施。
desc_original: A private sector panel is preparing a letter to the prime minister urging the government to accelerate efforts to strengthen Thailand's preparedness for future flooding.

title: Bangkok faces submersion risk
desc: Bangkok could have as much as one-third of its area permanently submerged by 2050 if the government fails to overhaul the country's water-management system and take more aggressive action on climate change, environmental and water-management experts warned at a forum.
title_cn: 曼谷面临沉没风险
summary_cn: 环保人士警告，若政府不能改革水资源管理系统、加强气候行动，曼谷到2050年可能有三分之一的区域被永久沉没。这涉及泰国首都的未来发展和防灾规划。
desc_original: Bangkok could have as much as one-third of its area permanently submerged by 2050 if the government fails to overhaul the country's water-management system and take more aggressive action on climate change, environmental and water-management experts warned at a forum.

desc_original: One Flag Thailand has completed its first world-record mission, flying a 4,303-square-foot Thai national flag over Pattaya.

title: ThaiHealth funding debate heats up

desc_original: The government's plan to end ThaiHealth's earmarked alcohol and tobacco tax funding of more than 4 billion baht a year has drawn mixed views over fiscal scrutiny, independence and public health.

title: Govt moves to protect meet
desc: The government has developed a business continuity plan to ensure the 2026 IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings run smoothly, even if heavy rainfall mars the global gathering, said Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

desc_original: The government has developed a business continuity plan to ensure the 2026 IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings run smoothly, even if heavy rainfall mars the global gathering, said Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

title: Fighter jet tyre bursts on Ubon runway, diverts Bangkok flights
desc: Fighter jet tyre bursts on Ubon runway, diverts Bangkok flights Legacy An F-5 TH fighter jet suffered a tyre blowout while landing at Ubon Ratchathani Airport today, October 7, temporarily closing the runway and forcing some passenger flights from Bangkok to turn back . The Royal Thai Air Force said the aircraft, operated by Squadron 211 of Wing 21 in Ubon Ratchathani, developed the problem on the runway at around 11.30am. The incident affected incoming commercial flights while airport staff worked to move the disabled aircraft and clear the runway. Among the affected services were AirAsia flight FD3374 from Don Mueang to Ubon Ratchathani and Thai VietJet flight VZ220 from Suvarnabhumi to Ubon Ratchathani. Photo via ป้อนป้อนพาเที่ยว Both were among the flights unable to land while the runway was closed for safety reasons and had to return to Bangkok. The Air Force said the problem was caused by one of the fighter jet’s tyres bursting during landing. It added that this type of failure can occur with aircraft and may be caused by a wheel hitting an object or other foreign material on the runway during touchdown. Airport rescue personnel and other relevant teams immediately inspected

title: 27 provinces, Bangkok remain flooded as crisis continues
desc: 27 provinces, Bangkok remain flooded as crisis continues Legacy Flooding remains across 27 provinces and Bangkok , affecting more than 3.16 million people and leaving 52 dead as heavy rain and runoff from northern Thailand continue to worsen conditions across central and eastern regions. The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM) said at 6am today, October 7, that floods were affecting 123 districts, 984 subdistricts and 7,215 villages, covering 1,154,875 households and 3,160,972 people. The affected provinces are Mae Hong Son, Chiang Mai, Lamphun, Nan, Phayao, Tak, Nakhon Sawan, Uthai Thani, Lop Buri, Sing Buri, Chai Nat, Suphan Buri, Kanchanaburi, Ang Thong, Saraburi, Ayutthaya, Samut Prakan, Pathum Thani, Nakhon Pathom, Ratchaburi, Samut Songkhram, Phetchaburi, Nakhon Nayok, Prachin Buri, Chachoengsao, Chon Buri and Rayong, along with Bangkok. Photo via JS100 Radio Prachin Buri recorded the highest death toll, with 19 people killed and 59,934 households affected across all seven districts. Water levels there were still rising. title: Your health insurance may not give you the specialist you want
desc: Your health insurance may not give you the specialist you want Legacy At many private hospitals in Thailand, choosing a specialist is easier than working out what your outpatient insurance will pay for. The online appointment system gives patients two options: ask the hospital to recommend a doctor or choose the doctor yourself. Some hospitals also let patients search by speciality, language and preferred date, with instant booking available for some doctors. For an expat using Thailand’s private healthcare system, finding the right specialist is usually straightforward; the insurance side is less obvious. Being free to book a cardiologist, neurologist or orthopaedic specialist does not mean your policy will pay for that consultation in the way you expect. The answer can depend on whether the appointment counts as outpatient care, how the provider is paid and what happens if the first consultation leads to scans, procedures or hospital treatment. desc: Around 2,000 pigs drown in Prachin Buri farm floods Legacy Around 2,000 pigs drowned after flash floods hit a large farm in Prachin Buri, prompting livestock officials to deploy more than 50 staff and heavy machinery to remove and bury the carcasses . title: Phuket launches Licence Lab to help small stays get licensed
desc: Phuket launches Licence Lab to help small stays get licensed Legacy Phuket has launched the “ Phuket Licence Lab ” to help small and medium-sized accommodation businesses overcome building and regulatory problems that have prevented many from obtaining the licences needed to operate legally . Five organisations from the professional, academic and tourism sectors signed a memorandum of understanding for the project on October 5 at Phuket City Development Company, or PKCD, in Mueang Phuket district. The project was developed because many small and medium-sized accommodation businesses in Phuket remain unable to obtain licences, often because their buildings were constructed before certain regulations came into force. Common obstacles include fire exits, fire protection systems, building setbacks and open-space requirements, urban planning rules, wastewater treatment systems and land ownership documents. These problems can affect both guest safety and the ability of operators to bring their businesses into compliance. desc: GMM MUSIC เปิดผลประกอบการครึ่งปีแรก กวาดรายได้ 2,161.2 ล้านบาท โตขึ้น 12.2% กำไรสุทธิ 280.7 ล้านบาท เพิ่มขึ้น 29.2% สวนเศรษฐกิจซบ ย้ำเป็นธุรกิจหลักที่แข็งแกร่งของ GMM GRAMMY
title_cn: GMM Music 上半年利润暴增 29.2%
summary_cn: 泰国音乐娱乐公司 GMM Music（GMM GRAMMY 旗下）公布上半年财报：营收 21.61 亿泰铢，同比增长 12.2%；净利润 2.807 亿泰铢，增幅达 29.2%。音乐版权、艺人经纪和演艺活动成为核心增长动力。在经济整体疲软背景下，GMM Music 仍保持强劲盈利表现，成为集团的业绩支柱。
